name: OGBL-PPA: Protein-Protein Association Link Prediction Benchmark
description: OGBL-PPA is a biological link property prediction benchmark constructed from protein-protein association networks across 58 distinct species in the STRING database. It contains 576,289 protein nodes and 30,326,273 undirected association edges. Each node is annotated with a 58-dimensional one-hot vector indicating its species identity. The task is to predict whether two proteins associate or interact based on a high-throughput biological data split, testing model capability to identify protein interactions not previously detected by low-throughput experiments, evaluated via Hits@100 against 3,000,000 negative edges per split.
